Logan / Vivek,

Thanks for the context. After modeling a few downside scenarios (attached redline + model), my recommendation to keep Redwood protected while being flexible is below. Attached: proposed_addendum_redline.pdf (redline with tracked changes) and SOC2_Type2_Attestation.pdf.

Recommendation (high level):
- Early-exit credit: 10% of remaining committed value (applied pro rata) if HealthWave chooses to terminate during months 7-12. This replaces full acceleration.
- 6-month opt-out window: HealthWave may initiate a formal opt-out notice any time after month 6 with 30 days' notice; opt-out triggers the early-exit credit if termination is chosen.
- Staged ramp schedule (if opting to step down rather than terminate):
  * Month 7-9: 80% of committed units
  * Month 10-12: 50% of committed units
  * Any further downsell after month 12 requires 60 days' notice and may be subject to separate review.
- Downsell fees: For step-downs, apply a flat step-down fee equal to 5% of the delta in monthly committed spend for the first two step-downs; this limits financial churn while avoiding full acceleration.
- Commercial protections: require 30 days' notice for any step-down, require prepayment for first 2 months of committed spend to secure onboarding discounts, and include a clause allowing Redwood to trigger a re-rate or revert to standard terms if usage exceeds 120% of committed units for any 90-day window.

Key risks & notes:
- This is a material concession vs. full acceleration; modeled TCV downside (worst case) ~11% (below the 12% threshold).
- Legal redline includes a cap on cumulative early-exit credits per account to avoid repeat exploitation.
- If we accept, require Procurement to accept a non-refundable onboarding deposit (first month) and a clause that HealthWave cannot repeatedly opt out within a 24-month period without exec renewal.

Request: Exec approval to present this addendum to HealthWave as a one-time concession for HW-2026-78. If approved, Deal Desk will prepare a final addendum and DocuSign envelope.

Attachments: proposed_addendum_redline.pdf, SOC2_Type2_Attestation.pdf
